name: Bending Bower
effect: Lay a bent near-ground lane for90 updates. Ordinary enemies touching it take32-Q4 once and are slowed modestly while inside. It does not immobilize a boss or extend beyond wall occlusion. Field: Grow a temporary L-shaped support only between two tagged root sockets; the unmarked outer walkway always stays open.

name: Banked Spiral
effect: Hold a short charge behind the caster for36 updates, then release one48-Q4 forward ember. It stops at scenery and the first enemy; changing owner/scene cancels without a cooldown refund. Field: Bank warmth at one tagged plate, then release it to one visible seam in the same cast/scene. No heat or proof can travel through a doorway.

name: Patient Ground
effect: Create one24px-radius grounded zone for120 updates. An ordinary enemy crossing its edge takes32-Q4 once; player knockback is shortened while standing inside, without immunity or damage reduction. Field: Seat a tagged tilting slab from the correct side and hold it until the marked load leaves; it cannot lift the player across an untagged gap.

name: Answering Edge
effect: Sweep a short offset crescent for32-Q4 once per enemy. A second visual beat only interrupts an ordinary projectile on its outer edge; it does not deal a second hit or reflect boss hazards. Field: Sound one tagged plate through an open acoustic gap; a solid or closed screen blocks it. The visible outline lasts60 updates as a clue, not a permanent route permission.

name: Open Shelter
effect: Unfold a stationary three-sided shelter for100 updates. Ordinary projectiles touching its thin outer edge are cancelled, maximum2; its open mouth and all contact attacks remain dangerous. No invulnerability. Field: Open a tagged leaf canopy toward one of two beds; preserve an intentional gap for their light path.

name: Waiting Wake
effect: Send a hooked ground wake for48 updates; deal32-Q4 once per ordinary enemy and displace it at most8px if the destination is collision-free. Bosses take only allowed exposed damage and never move. Field: Steady a tagged light ferry at its marked stop; choose which side receives ballast before release. Does not carry a player through walls.

name: Last Ember
effect: Place one warm veil for120 updates. It cancels at most2 ordinary projectiles crossing its front; after a visible60-update settling delay, its outer rim deals32-Q4 once per enemy. It never heals or clears authored boss hazards. Field: Keep one tagged heat seam warm while the adjoining shelter mouth remains open. Closing the mouth intentionally cancels the field action.
